Method of Attack: Encrypts VMware ESXi server files (.vmxf, .vmx, .vmdk, .vmsd, .nvra) using ransomware
Exploits OpenSLP security flaw (CVE-2021-21974) for unauthenticated remote code execution
Attack Vector: Exploitation of OpenSLP service vulnerability (CVE-2021-21974) on unpatched ESXi servers
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom notes named 'ransom.html' and 'How to Restore Your Files.html'
